about: Rich words for Word Clues, written for this app at about a 2nd to 3rd grade reading level. Each entry has a 3-sentence story that uses the word once and gives clues to its meaning, the meaning plus two wrong meanings, and a new sentence with a blank (___) where only this word fits; notFit lists two other words from this file that clearly don't fit that blank. Characters are made up.

It was longer than a school bus!
Its tail was as wide as a car.
words.use: The ___ cake was so big it filled the whole table.
